name: ETL Record Cleaner & Transformer
description: Implement a robust data transformation function `clean_records(records)` in `app.py`. Given a list of dirty dictionary records: (1) Deduplicate records keeping the latest entry per unique integer `id`; (2) Coerce string numerical amounts (e.g., '12.50', '$40') to positive floats; (3) Validate email format (must contain '@' and '.') dropping records with invalid emails; (4) Set default `status='active'` if missing; (5) Return cleaned records sorted by `id` ascending.
visible_hint: Records with duplicate IDs should keep the most recently seen record in the list.
